attributes.headline: Downloading Invoices
attributes.body:
Invoices are available under **Billing → History** for the last 24 months.

Choose the invoice and select Download to get a PDF. If the download fails, it is usually a browser blocking the pop-up — allow pop-ups for our site and try once more.

If an invoice is missing entirely, it has not been issued yet; invoices are generated on the first working day of the month.
